components.title: Components
components.description: What the version contains; null when not enumerated.

content_scan.description: This version's content scan; null when it has not been scanned.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Who uploaded this version; null when not recorded.

description.title: Description
description.description: The manifest's description; null when it declares none. The value can be longer than 500 characters, the limit on `description` in an uploaded manifest. A description that the manifest takes from a `SKILL.md` is cut to its first 500 characters. So if the manifest's description is the first 500 characters of exactly one distinct skill `description` in `components`, that skill `description` is returned instead.
examples: Reviews pull requests against your team's conventions.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: The manifest's display name; null when it declares none.

manifest_version.title: Manifest Version
manifest_version.description: The manifest's `version`, normalized for display: one leading `v` or `V` is dropped, and the result is returned only if it is 1 to 64 characters, starts with a digit, and uses only ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `+`, and `-`; otherwise `null`. For example, `"v1.4.0"` is returned as `"1.4.0"`, and `"latest"` as `null`. For a synchronized plugin, the `version` of its `marketplace.json` entry can take the place of the manifest's `version`. It is also `null` for a version stored before claude.ai began recording this field (August 2026).

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: How far the version reaches: `remote`, `privileged`, `contained`, or `null`, as defined on the Plugin's `reach`.

release_notes.title: Release Notes
release_notes.description: As supplied with the upload; null when none were supplied.
examples: Adds a review checklist for database migrations.
